scope: General evidence-to-law architecture. It does not determine the legal effect of any particular property's documents without property-specific evidence and applicable law.
evidence_boundary: A record establishes only what the record can properly establish.
A legal proposition requires the applicable statute, rule, case law or other authoritative source.
A legal effect may require multiple matched records and legal provisions.
Where a required condition is unresolved, the answer must remain qualified.
official_source_basis: Tailte Éireann property-registration and copy-service information
publication_contract: FACT → SCOPE → LAW → EFFECT → CONDITIONS → UNESTABLISHED MATTERS → NEXT ROUTE
